name: HealthKitType
title: Apple HealthKit type identifiers
description: The HealthKit type identifiers the healthkit-archive app reads. Every Observation carries its HealthKit type as a coding in this system, so it can be traced back to the source type. The `kind` property gives the HealthKit class and `mapping` how the type appears in FHIR. The codes are Apple's identifier strings; their meaning is defined by Apple's HealthKit documentation.

property.description: quantity, category, correlation, workout or data (series and other objects).
How hka fhir map represents values of this type.
